subject: maths
question: A vehicle is going at one-fourth of its usual speed and it takes an extra 45 minutes to reach its destination. Its usual time to cover the same distance is:
solution:
**Given:**

New speed = 1/4 of usual speed

Extra time = 45 minutes = 0.75 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Since new speed is 1/4 of the usual, it takes 4 times longer to cover the same distance.

Let usual time = T hours

New time = 4T

Extra time taken = New time - usual time

⇒ 0.75 = 4T - T

⇒ 3T = 0.75

⇒ T = 0.75/3

⇒ T = 0.25 hours

**Usual time to cover the distance = 0.25 hours or 15 minutes**
